source.title: Wedding-day at Troldhaugen, Op. 65 No. 6
source.edition: G. Schirmer, 1903, edited by Louis Oesterle

bars.description: Play the 4/4 march, bars 1–56, and the 2/4 Poco tranquillo, bars 57–106; repeat the source's volta section, bars 75–106, once; then the written-out Tempo I return and coda, bars 107–179.

endpoints.basis: The opening lower-staff D2/A2 quarter rises near 2.1 s, followed by the upper D3/A3 eighths; the initial broad window wrongly selected bar 2's repeated D/A downbeat near 4.2 s despite passing numerical gates. The final fff D-major chord (D1/A1/D2 bass, D5/F-sharp5/A5/D6 treble) rises near 408.8 s after the bar-178 staccato near 407.8 s.

anchors.label: bar-107-Tempo-I-D2-A2
anchors.basis: MEAS: performed q388 is the lower-staff D2/A2 quarter opening the Tempo I return, bar 107, after the pause that ends the repeated Poco tranquillo. In the initial 256–264-s pitch-energy overlay the D2/A2/D3/A3 bands and the onset envelope stay silent from about 259.7 s until a joint rise near 261.4 s, whereas the unconstrained map put this downbeat at 260.85 s inside the silence. Inspected source-pitch fitting constraint, not independent or aural validation.

provenance: EXT: Mutopia 781 transcribes the G. Schirmer 1903 edition edited by Louis Oesterle; the listen module already cites that Oesterle edition for its bar references. Labels identify the two printed staves, not separated hands or contrapuntal voices.

The LilyPond 2.8.4 source is converted only in a disposable copy and compiled with LilyPond 2.24.4. The legacy published MIDI unfolds the repeat and carries old grace-note timing drift, so a strict pitch/onset identity comparison is not configured; every one of its attacks is matched by pitch within 0.15 quarter in the modern unfolded compilation, which additionally retains same-pitch grace/main-note rearticulations the legacy file coalesced.
